name: Onesimus
title: The Freed Slave
summary: Onesimus was a Roman slave belonging to Philemon, a Christian in Colossae. He fled from his master, met the apostle Paul in prison, and converted to Christianity. Paul sent him back to Philemon with a letter urging reconciliation and treating Onesimus as a brother in Christ.

keyEvents.title: The Flight from Philemon
keyEvents.description: Onesimus fled from his master Philemon, possibly after stealing from him or incurring debt.

keyEvents.title: Meeting Paul in Prison
keyEvents.description: During his flight, Onesimus met the apostle Paul, who was imprisoned, and converted to Christianity through his preaching.

keyEvents.title: Becomes Paul's Spiritual Son
keyEvents.description: Paul refers to Onesimus as his child, whom he has begotten in prison, and developed a close spiritual relationship with him.

keyEvents.title: Sent Back to Philemon
keyEvents.description: Paul sent Onesimus back to Philemon with a personal letter urging him to receive him as a brother, not as a slave.

keyEvents.title: The journey with Tychicus to Colossae
keyEvents.description: Onesimus traveled with Tychicus to deliver letters to the church in Colossae and to Philemon personally.
